name: zerodha-mutual-fund-sell-liquid-after-the-load-period
describes: The same liquid scheme redeemed on the eighth day, which is the half of AC-6 the word *only* carries: the predicate is false, the rule contributes nothing, and the redemption is genuinely free. The broker's card prices direct funds at nil brokerage (Zerodha: "All direct mutual fund investments are absolutely free"), so the redemption reads as RESOLVED at zero with a BROKERAGE 0.00 line (D-382). Before W-163b the card carried no brokerage rule and this read as NO_MATCHING_RULES, a gap that was not one.
